name: Apex Group
verdict: Majority-owned by the US private-equity firm Genstar Capital. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of SailGP; also title partner of the Apex Group Bermuda Sail Grand Prix and an official partner of the United States team. Rating note (2026-09-30): Abu Dhabi's sovereign fund Mubadala holds a minority stake in Apex (its own site calls it a 'strategic minority stake', since 2022); the size is not public, so the 5%-or-control link test cannot be met, and control rests with Genstar Capital. Rated none.
